# Configuration files

Every key in every file under `configs/`, with the committed value and the comment written next to it in the file (empty when the file has none). Lists are summarised by length. Application settings and their environment variables are on [Settings and environment variables](config.md).

## `category_remap.yaml`

Deterministic post-hoc category remap for the teacher labels (C2.3b; v2 after the gold-150 review). Quality-100 found the same theme labelled differently across rows; one category per theme. A rule fires on the risk TITLE (the first 200 chars of the body when the risk has no title); the first matching rule wins. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes. subject_only: match only the title before its consequence clause ("X may adversely affect our business, reputation ..." -> "X"), so a word that is only a consequence does not fire. exclude: the rule is skipped when one of these matches the title. Counts per rule are written to eval_results/c/teacher_cleanup_report.json.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `remap-v2` | Version of the remap rules, stored with the cleaned labels. |
| `rules` | *list, 12 entries* | Remap rules: `name`, `target` category, `patterns`, optional `subject_only` and `exclude`. |

## `demo_ipos.yaml`

Demo set: RHP + final Prospectus per IPO. PDFs live in data/raw/ (gitignored); this file is committed. doc_id = "doc_" + the first 16 hex of sha256 (B-ADR-14); the RHP is the showcase report's primary doc, the Prospectus its companion (prices). split: dev = tune rules/thresholds/extractor choice; test = numbers reported in the report (ADR-026).

| Key | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ipos` | *list, 10 entries* | The 10 showcase IPOs: id, split, company, and RHP / Prospectus files with page count and SHA-256. |

## `fields.yaml`

Field registry (02 section 7, ADR-023). One entry per extracted field. doc: the document the value is normally read from. sections: where to look (cover = first pages). extractor: rules \| table (ADR-018: rules first on every field). fallback: what runs when the primary finds nothing; every other extractor that finds a value only confirms or doubts it (the fine-tuned QA model). ladder: false = excluded from weak labels and the model ladder (B4, ADR-023).

| Key | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fields` | *list, 11 entries* | One entry per fact-sheet field: id, labels, type, document, sections, questions, extractor. |

## `forbidden_phrases.yaml`

Forbidden phrases (B01 §6, B-ADR-13): instruction-style phrases and verdicts on an IPO, not single words. Shared by the UI copy test and every model rewrite (teacher filter, student post-check). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched after the allow-list is removed. Change this file only with a test showing what the change blocks or lets through.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allow` | *list, 9 entries* | Fixed lines removed before matching, so disclaimers pass. |
| `patterns` | *list, 11 entries* | Case-insensitive regexes for advice-style phrases; a match blocks the text. |

## `reference.yaml`

Rolling reference window (C02 §5, C-ADR-03): "past IPOs" for a document are those dated before it within the last window_years. Corpus IPOs (close year only) count when their close year is in the window_years calendar years before the as-of year. Read by finsight.splits.reference.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `window_years` | `4` | Years before a document that count as "past IPOs". |

## `risklevel.yaml`

Risk level (B02 §7.4, B-ADR-11). Fitted by C2.8 (C-ADR-25): thresholds are the terciles of the full score (red flags + rare-risk points) of the 165 train + dev IPOs that are full documents; corpus_n and computed_on come from the fit. The UI shows corpus_n from here, never a typed number.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `provisional` | false | False once the thresholds were fitted (C-ADR-25). |
| `window_years` | `4` | Years of past IPOs in the reference window. |
| `computed_on` | `1a32ec6` | Commit of the fit. |
| `corpus_n` | `165` | Past IPOs the thresholds were fitted on. |
| `points` | `{ concern: 2, watch: 1, risk: 1, max_risk_points: 4 }` | Points per Concern, per Watch and per rare serious risk, and the cap on risk points. |
| `unusual_below` | `0.1` | a high-seriousness risk below this novelty adds a point |
| `thresholds` | `{ low_below: 0.2857, high_from: 0.4167 }` | Score share below `low_below` is Low; at or above `high_from` is High. |
| `show_percentile` | false | Reference scores at percentiles 0, 10, ..., 100 (for "more disclosed risk than p% of past IPOs"). C-ADR-28: the percentile is hidden (null + note): long RHPs scored "riskier than 95%" by length. |
| `reference_quantiles` | `[0.0, 0.125, 0.2114, 0.2778, 0.3125, 0.35, 0.3889, 0.4286, 0.4555, 0.5678, 0.75]` | Reference scores; used only if `show_percentile` is true. |
| `behind_click` | false | B01 §10.2: hide the level behind a click if the teacher asks |

## `splits.yaml`

Phase 3 time split (C02 §4, C-ADR-02). Written by `python -m finsight.splits build`; never edit by hand. Once frozen, it changes only by a new C-ADR.

Keys not listed: the file is written by `python -m finsight.splits build`; never edited by hand.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `1` | Split file version. |
| `frozen` | true | True: the split changes only by a new C-ADR. |
| `rule` | `strict` | Split rule (`strict` time split). |
| `train_cut` | `2025-06-19` | Documents dated after this are never training data. |
| `rules` | *(section)* | Shares used to build the split. |
| `changed_by_adr` | `C-ADR-24` | Decisions that changed the frozen split. |
| `counts` | *(section)* | Documents per slice. |
| `ipos` | *list, 664 entries* | Every IPO with its slice. |
| `excluded` | *list, 14 entries* | IPOs left out, with the reason. |
| `demo` | `nityas-gems-and-jewellery-india-2026, srit-india-2026, shah-investor-s-home-2026` | Newest IPOs kept for the demo only. |
| `bench` | *list, 7 entries* | The 7 FinSight Bench v1 IPOs. |
| `bench_dev` | `[]` | Bench development IPOs (none). |

## `suggested_questions.yaml`

Suggested questions per IPO (06: /suggested-questions). {fresh_lakh} is the fresh-issue amount in crore written with the wrong unit ("lakh"): the scale trick. Filled from the IPO's X-Ray; the trick question is dropped when the X-Ray has no fresh-issue amount.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `questions` | *list, 5 entries* | Question chips under the chat (the `language: hi` entry is not shown since v1.1). |

## `ipo_universe.csv`

Not a setting: the list of recent RHPs (2024–2026) behind the Phase 3 corpus, written by `scripts/build_ipo_universe.py`. See [Data](../data/index.md).
